decisive_items: Revealed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis
Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by suprabasal acantholysis, intercellular IgG/C3, and anti-Dsg1/3 antibodies, which are diagnostic of pemphigus vulgaris. R1 is unsupported as paraneoplastic pemphigus requires distinct features and associated neoplasia. C1 is a redundant completion of R2 with no additional raw evidence.

rejected.why: Lacks specific histopathologic and serologic evidence; only cites history and lesion.
Correlated restatement of R2 with identical raw support; discounted as redundant.
